verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents native workflow triggers that notify, update or validate records, plus automatic bank-feed import and categorization. Bank Rules can be created and managed via API, and Zia AI handles tasks like bulk collection reminders and workflow Blueprints, so background automations run without manual steps. Zoho MCP is also described as supporting fully autonomous agents that act without human input. Missing for 10: detailed docs on trigger types, scheduling and execution of background workflows; independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably; autonomous-agent operation depends on an external LLM via the sign-in-gated MCP service rather than a native agent.
